message.content: {"title":"AERO9500 Report Marking Rubric (Assignment Part 2)","total":null,"criteria":[{"id":"C1","name":"Introduction: mission concept and rationale","weight":10,"max":null,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"Addresses all requirements to a high standard; detailed descriptions and discussions; appropriate literature references."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Addresses some requirements; descriptions may lack specific details and/or have incomplete referencing."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"Many or all requirements not addressed; poor descriptions or lack of appropriate referencing."}]},{"id":"C2","name":"Main body: mission design","weight":60,"max":null,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"High-level understanding of design procedure; design clearly addresses mission and course concepts; all major requirements addressed and well supported with quality evidence (software screenshots, software files, hand calculations, literature references); content comprehensive, accurate, persuasive."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Adequate understanding of design procedure; design may be inconsistent in purpose/clarity or contain errors; major requirements addressed but may lack detail or evidence; content may not be comprehensive and/or persuasive."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"Minimal understanding of design procedure; major requirements not addressed and/or lack evidence; content incomplete or not persuasive."}]},{"id":"C3","name":"Conclusion","weight":10,"max":null,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"Detailed and appropriate conclusions reached from the evidence provided in the report."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Some conclusions reached but may be generic or lack specific detail."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"No actual or useful conclusions reached."}]},{"id":"C4","name":"Report presentation","weight":20,"max":null,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"Clear, logical engineering report structure; easy to read: well-written, good spelling and grammar, appropriate language style; consistent formatting throughout; executive summary/abstract provides concise overview; graphical and tabular data presentation appropriate, clear, consistent; in-text references match reference list (and vice versa) and are cited properly."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Not professional level but uses headings/subheadings to indicate structure; may be difficult to read: writing just ok, broad idea comes across; some spelling/grammar flaws, language style not quite appropriate; figures and tables labelled but formatting unclear and/or inconsistent enough that reader can lose context; in-text references match reference list (and vice versa) and mostly cited correctly."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"Poorly structured, not coherent, or shows lack of understanding of section purposes; much effort required to read and understand: poor writing, many spelling/grammar mistakes, possibly inappropriate language style (e.g. too informal); presentation poor enough to impede reading (e.g. inconsistent formatting, unlabelled figures or tables); references not cited or cited inconsistently."}]}],"notes":"Assignment Part 2; 25% of course grade. Level marks use a common 0–10 scale per criterion. Introduction requirements: primary mission, why needed, number of spacecraft and why, users (operator and customers). Main body requirements: launch site and vehicle with rationale, orbit type/characteristics/elements, orbital maneuvers, ground control facilities, communication frequency with ground control, mission duration and EOL plans; include software and/or hand calculations, relevant screenshots and software files in main body and/or appendix."}
